decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with enter the battlefield effects and sacrifice outlets to generate value and create powerful board states. By tutoring for specific creatures with Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can create synergistic interactions and combo off with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck also includes cards like Blood Artist and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons to leverage sacrifice effects and drain the opponent's life total. With a mix of aggressive creatures and utility cards, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a versatile toolbox of creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing cascading spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that brings all creatures from both players' graveyards onto the battlefield. By cycling cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will, the deck aims to fill the graveyard with creatures and then use Living End to create a massive board presence, overwhelming the opponent. The inclusion of Force of Negation provides protection for the combo, while cards like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves provide additional value and options for the player.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to fill the graveyard with value creatures, then casting Living End to return them all to the battlefield. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a massive board presence while disrupting their own strategy with cards like Force of Negation. The deck also includes cards like Violent Outburst and Curator of Mysteries to further control the game and ensure a powerful combo finish. Overall, the key concept is to quickly fill the graveyard and cheat powerful creatures into play with Living End.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate a loop where artifacts can be continuously milled and recurred from the graveyard to eventually win the game with Thassa's Oracle. Other key cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help to control the game and provide additional value. The use of Mox Amber and Mishra's Bauble allows for fast mana acceleration and card draw to help set up the combo.

This deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent with efficient, low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting their game plan with hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize. The deck also has removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats on the board. Blood Moon can disrupt the opponent's mana base while Seasoned Pyromancer provides card advantage and board presence. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Primeval Titan, Amulet of Vigor, and various bounce lands to create a combo that allows for explosive ramp and the ability to search for and play powerful lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens. It also utilizes cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Arboreal Grazer to accelerate its game plan. The goal is to quickly assemble the pieces needed to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and land-based combos while utilizing powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures for additional value.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful planeswalkers, removal spells, and efficient creatures to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By maintaining board presence and consistently removing threats, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent, ultimately leading to victory through a combination of card advantage and strong win conditions. With a mix of control elements and versatile threats, the deck is designed to handle a variety of opponents and adapt to different matchups effectively.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing Cascade mechanics to cast powerful spells for free while maintaining a tempo advantage. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and disruption. This Aggro-Cascade strategy is supported by a mix of versatile spells like Fire / Ice, Dead / Gone, and Force of Negation to control the board and protect key threats. The deck also includes a small selection of lands and creatures to provide additional utility and flexibility in different matchups.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to cheat out powerful creatures like Primeval Titan. The key strategy is to use bounce lands and Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana, allowing for explosive plays and the ability to search for key lands and combo pieces with cards like Explore and Summoner's Pact. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and land synergies to quickly close out the game.

The deck aims to control the game through counterspells and removal while ramping up mana using cards like Growth Spiral and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. The key strategy is to use Scapeshift to sacrifice lands and search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle along with multiple Mountains to deal a large amount of damage to the opponent in one turn. Wrenn and Six provide recursion for lands while Expressive Iteration helps with card selection. The deck includes a mix of utility lands and versatile spells to maintain board control and win the game through a massive Valakut trigger.

This deck focuses on quickly pressuring opponents with fast creatures and disruption, using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply early pressure. It also leverages powerful discard spells like Thoughtseize to disrupt opponents' game plans while using removal spells like Terminate to deal with threats. The deck aims to close out games quickly before opponents have a chance to stabilize, while also utilizing cards like Blood Moon to punish greedy mana bases. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck looks to overwhelm opponents and secure victories.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through removal spells and disruption, while ramping up mana with lands like Valakut and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. The primary win condition is to cast Scapeshift and sacrifice lands to search for Valakut and other Mountains to deal lethal damage to the opponent. Cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide versatility and card advantage, while Omnath and Valki offer additional threats. Leyline Binding and Supreme Verdict help to control the board, allowing the player to secure victory through careful planning and resource management.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. The deck also leverages Leyline Binding to lockdown opponent's key threats, while utilizing The One Ring as a win condition. The creature package includes versatile options like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Delighted Halfling to provide a strong board presence. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its diverse color requirements and provide flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as versatile removal spells such as Prismatic Ending and Leyline Binding. The deck also includes threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game quickly. The mana base is designed to support a variety of colors for flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing a dominant board presence.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating incremental advantage with powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. Using cards like Chalice of the Void and Leyline Binding, it aims to lock down the opponent's key cards and strategies. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to outlast its opponent and eventually win the game through card advantage and powerful finishers like Solitude and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy through powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six and Nissa, Resurgent Animist to generate value and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to slow down the game with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude while also ramping into big threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation. The deck also includes combo pieces like The One Ring and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to potentially win the game in a single turn.
